# DOCX fixtures

`tables.docx` and `tiny-picture.docx` are copied unmodified from `mammoth`'s own test suite
(`node_modules/mammoth/test/test-data/`), BSD-2-Clause licensed (Copyright (c) 2013, Michael
Williamson) — reused here rather than hand-authored so the fixtures are real, valid OOXML
rather than a minimal file that happens to satisfy one parser version.
